content.value: The following observation were made on a boiler plant during one hour test: Steam pressure = 20 bar, superheated steam temperature $\mathrm { \Omega } = 3 6 0 ^ { \mathrm { { 0 } } } \mathrm { C } ,$ , steam generated = 5000 kg, temperature of water entering the economiser $= 2 5 ^ { 0 } \mathrm { C } ,$ temperature of water leaving the economiser $= 9 2 ^ { \overline { { 0 } } } \mathrm { C } .$ , fuel used = 4000 kg, higher calorific value of fuel = 30000 kJ/kg. Calculate – (i) Equivalent evaporation per kg of fuel, (ii) The thermal efficiency of the plant, (iii) The percentage of heat absorbed of the fuel energy utilized by economiser and boiler, (iv) Boiler power.
